tool_args.rationale: The maximum pilot gradient, 2.44, enters the gray zone but remains below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The targeted probe costs 3.0 and can distinguish continued smooth saturation from an above-threshold drop before fitting the forecast law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth square-root siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A good pilot fit would not establish that the smooth law remains valid above the suspected threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter threshold-avalanche siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients lie below the proposed threshold range, so the avalanche penalty is zero there and neither threshold parameter is identifiable.
It costs more and does not directly target the missing above-threshold gradient contrast.
Drive and sink gradient rise together in the pilot, so the flattening alone does not identify drive-only inhibition.
